integrity: The channel factorization is exact algebra from the published formulas; the spectral and counting consequences use only explicitly cited theorems. Numerical replay is corroborative and is not used as proof.
limitations: Restricted to the natural diagonal slice \(\gamma=0\) with \(\alpha,\beta>0\).
Does not classify the full off-diagonal \(\gamma\ne0\) transition geometry.
The bicritical count uses the bounded comparison error of the primary source rather than refining it.
title: Rectangular two-threshold phase diagram for diagonal Smilansky–Solomyak contact interactions
